problem: Customer has not received their order
solution: Open the Orders section, select the order, and check the latest tracking status.

problem: Payment was deducted but the order was not confirmed
solution: Check the transaction status. If the payment failed, verify whether the amount was automatically reversed.
Select Forgot Password and follow the reset instructions sent to the registered email.

problem: Customer has not received their refund
solution: Check the refund processing status and the expected bank processing period.

problem: Tracking says delivered but customer has not received the package
solution: Check whether the package was received by a neighbour, family member, or building security. Verify the delivery confirmation and contact the delivery support team to investigate the missing package.
